card.name: Numbers just before adverse-effect headings
card.fires_on: Numbers, spaces and short words in label text where a section or grade number is being written, such as the digit in a 5.x section number or the space after "Grade". Also seen inside "Oligohydramnios" and after "and" in a dose sentence.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a warnings section number like 5.4, right before a heading such as Toxicity or Effects.

modes.label: Toxicity grade
modes.description: The space or symbol before the grade number in dose-modification tables.

modes.label: Other spots
modes.description: Partway through the word Oligohydramnios, or the word "the" before dose in a withdrawal-severity sentence.

card.writes: It lowers the chance that the next word is "effects" or similar, so a heading is more likely to be a different word.
card.plain: It fires on section and grade numbers in drug labels, where a heading about toxicity or risk comes next rather than the word effects.
